<!--
Link the issue this PR is for. Use a closing keyword so GitHub closes it on merge:

  Closes #123          (the PR finishes the issue)
  Refs #123            (the PR is part of it; the issue stays open)

Several issues: repeat the keyword for each, e.g. "Closes #1, closes #2".
"Closes #1, #2" only closes #1.

No issue for it? Open one first, or write "No issue: <reason>" for trivial changes.

Stacked PRs: closing keywords only work when the PR merges into the default branch (main).
A PR merged into another branch closes nothing, and its changes only reach main when that
branch is merged too. Keep the "Closes" line in the PR that finally lands on main.
-->
